findings.evidence_snippet: Wizard renders 'QUELLE VIANDE ? 0/1 / Choisissez 1 viande' for item 488 'Big Cayenne'. DB has attr 307 [Viande 1] AND attr 308 [Viande 2] (4 variations each, both optional). POS V4 wizard for SAME item renders 'Viandes 0/2' correctly (S-POS-NEW-01-02-wizard-popup.png). Item description: '2 viandes au choix'. Root cause: resources/js/helpers/kioskTacosSize.js viandeCountFromName('Big Cayenne') returns null because SIZE_LABEL_REGEX doesn't match 'Big ...' pattern; KioskWizardComponent.detectViandeCount() falls back to 1 (line 975) ignoring attr 308 presence.
findings.claim: Kiosk wizard binding bug — Big Cayenne (488) renders 0/1 viande step despite DB attr 308 (Viande 2) + description '2 viandes au choix'; POS reads same DB and renders 0/2 correctly. GStack framed as 'owner decision A/B/C' but evidence shows Option A is mandatory: kiosk fallback must respect DB attr presence.
findings.fix_hint: Either (a) extend SIZE_LABEL_REGEX in kioskTacosSize.js to match /\bbig\b/i → 2, or (b) modify KioskWizardComponent.detectViandeCount() to consult itemAttributes for attr with name including 'viande 2' before falling back to 1 (mirror POS logic in pos-wizard.js viande detection branch).
